Product Features

  • Elegant designThe combination of panels and plastic rattan doors gives the shoe rack an elegant and functional look. Hidden shoe cabinets make efficient use of narrow spaces in hallways and corners and thus ensure order.
  • High Quality: The shoe cabinet is made of high-quality chipboard, which ensures the longevity and durability of this shoe storage. The eco-friendly chipboard and melamine coating can improve the appearance of the room.
  • Moisture resistance and cleaning: Compared with traditional shoe cabinets, the rattan surface design provides excellent ventilation, so your shoes dry quickly and prevent mold from forming. The cabinet has a floor space with a height of 12 cm, which not only allows you to store your shoes, but also allows for easy cleaning by a robot sweeper. Suitable for a smart home lifestyle.
  • EASY TO ASSEMBLE – Our shoe cabinet comes with clear instructions that show illustrations and mark all spare parts. All kinds of screws are labeled and packed in separate bags, also all parts are labeled. The smoothly painted surface is very easy to clean.
  • Versatile storage: This sideboard has adjustable shelves and offers customizable storage space to suit your needs. Easily organize and present your items.
  • Combination of classic and modern – The doors decorated with rattan combine aesthetic beauty with great practicality. The rat sideboard not only absorbs moisture and heat, but also provides a perfect visual effect and adds charm to your home.
  • Elegant Design: The sleek and modern design of the shoe cabinet features a smooth and polished finish that will suit any interior style, be it the living room or even the bedroom.
  • Customize your shoe storage with this versatile shoe cabinet. The adjustable shelves allow you to create compartments of different sizes, perfect for accommodating different types of shoes.
  • Easy to Clean: The smooth surfaces of this shoe cabinet make it easy to clean. Simply wipe off any dust or spills with a damp cloth for a flawless appearance.
  • The installation of this shoe cabinet is very easy. Clear and specific instructions, as well as all the necessary components and tools, are included with this product, so even a beginner assembly will have no problems assembling this well-made shoe cabinet.
